title: Footstool — Microcosm, Support and Hidden-Door Atlas
status: canonical project synthesis with comparative boundaries
purpose: Integrate Footstool as a positional and supporting project symbol while preserving its tiny microcosm, dirt/soil, hidden-Door, ascent-support and transformation meanings without equating lower position with lower human worth.
core_definition: Footstool is a lower, supporting or compressed relation beneath a higher Seat, Throne, path or perspective. In the July 2026 project microcosm it can be imagined as a tiny bounded patch of dirt containing a central Door that has not yet been found.
core_rule: Footstool primarily answers where or how something is positioned and what it supports. It is not by itself a moral essence, a statement of intrinsic worth or proof that the lower relation is permanent.

tiny_room_image.form: A deliberately tiny bounded local world or block.
tiny_room_image.meaning: The tiny scale represents limited perspective, compression and local support rather than lesser dignity.
tiny_room_image.door_paradox: The Door can already be inside the Footstool while remaining unseen or unused. The problem is therefore not always lack of passage; it can be failure of recognition.

typed_footstools.cosmic_footstool: Earth / world-below positioned beneath Heaven / Throne in project and biblical comparison.
typed_footstools.sacred_proximity_footstool: Lower position close to presence or sacred order; lower does not mean profane or disposable.
typed_footstools.conquest_footstool: Royal/biblical subjugation imagery where hostile power is placed beneath feet; this meaning must not silently colonize every project use.
typed_footstools.microcosmic_footstool: Tiny local mind/world with central Door present but unfound; a closed horizon rather than total absence of possibility.
typed_footstools.support_step_footstool: Ground or support appearing beneath an ascending agent, making further movement possible without implying the support itself has crossed the same threshold.
typed_footstools.soil_footstool: Dust/dirt/substrate that can remain inert or become material for Root, Potato, sprout and growth.

developmental_sequences.closure_variant: Dweller -> Mud Dweller -> Dog -> tswine -> Footstool
developmental_sequences.closure_meaning: Increasing fixation, compressed horizon or failure to use a known Door.
developmental_sequences.generative_meaning: assigned support -> responsive function -> generative possibility
developmental_sequences.door_route: Footstool -> recognition of center -> Door -> changed relation
developmental_sequences.soil_route: dust / dirt -> soil -> Root -> Potato -> sprout
developmental_sequences.noncontradiction_rule: Closure and development are different relation graphs. Footstool can represent endpoint in one graph and starting support-state in another.

july_2026_tension.july_26: Footstool is a very small local state whose central Door has not been found; Tim walking over Footstools toward Heaven belongs to project topology.
july_2026_tension.july_30: Recovered North-Pole mirror-gate scene depicts ground / Footstools appearing beneath ascent while Dogs attempting to follow meet the reflective boundary.
july_2026_tension.resolution: The support beneath an ascender need not share the ascender's state transition. A Footstool may function as ground for another's path while itself remaining locally bounded.

support_logic.support_without_identity: To support a higher path does not mean the support object is identical to the traveler, Throne or destination.
support_logic.temporary_ground: A step can be locally necessary without becoming the final world.
support_logic.healthy_support: Support stabilizes movement and can become soil for future growth.
support_logic.shadow_support: Support becomes prison when local function is treated as permanent identity and the hidden Door can no longer be imagined.

relations: Footstool -> Door: contains, approaches or fails to recognize central passage
Footstool -> Dog: static support can become responsive function in the generative sequence
Footstool -> Potato: dirt/soil can become generative substrate through Root and growth
Footstool -> Ascent: can act as successive ground beneath movement
Footstool -> Mud Dweller: may be endpoint of increasing closure in one role sequence

chronology_signals.development: Footstool joins Mud Dweller, Dog, Goat and orbit/lower-state language.
Footstool is integrated into House/Tree/Gardener/Drain spatial architecture.
Footstool becomes endpoint in Dweller -> Mud Dweller -> Dog -> Footstool sequence.
Footstool becomes a tiny microcosm with central Door present but unfound; richer sequence includes `tswine`.
Footstool/support-ground appears beneath North-Pole mirror-gate ascent in recovered creative/mythic material.
Recovered formulation relates Footstool to fixation, measurement and compressed lower detail.
Footstool becomes autobiographical prior state before Dog and Potato, emphasizing purpose through support before generativity.
Dust/Footstool imagery participates in a possible substrate-to-growth transformation sequence.

epistemic_boundaries: Footstool position does not imply lower intrinsic human worth.
Biblical cosmic, sacred and conquest footstools are distinct textual uses; Potatoverse synthesis must not merge them into one doctrine.
The tiny-room, dirt-block, hidden-Door and ascent-step formulations are project-specific symbolic developments.
Creative ascent scenes remain creative/mythic artifacts unless separately documented as direct doctrinal statements.
Dimensional language around Footstool is symbolic unless formally defined in science/formal-model contexts.
open_recovery_targets: Recover exact July 30 mirror-gate / support-ground conversation text and classify creative versus doctrinal portions.
Recover exact August fixation/measurement formulation and determine whether Footstool was explicitly named or later coupled.
Recover any earlier pre-April Footstool references that may precede the current genealogy.
